case: custom enum[] CSV import preserves null distinctions, lower bounds and dimensions
contract: An explicit CSV null marker distinguishes a SQL NULL array from an empty array and a one-element array containing SQL NULL.
A custom enum array with lower bound zero preserves its literal NULL label, SQL NULL element, empty label and Unicode element.
A two-dimensional custom enum array retains its dimensions, native type and JSON semantics after CSV import.
Native pg_typeof, array_dims, array_to_json and array_send values are compared before and after import; a pre-existing sibling row retains its exact wire bytes.

native_contract_group.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration array_contract:: -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-core -p tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Other PostgreSQL array families, spreadsheet-application re-import, installed array editing and additional enum/session configurations remain open in B3.
